Python — Request to run configuration

Correspond Python The public timeout configuration of the package to overwrite the default for a specific camera interface HTTP Timeout.

API Reference

set_timeout(key, seconds)

Purpose: The default timeout to overwrite the specified interface is immediately effective.

Parameters

Name Type Description

key

str

Value of key.

seconds

float

Value of seconds.

Returns: None;keys when they do not exist or seconds are invalid ValueError.

reset_timeout(key)

Purpose: Removes the timeout of an interface and restores the default.

Parameters

Name Type Description

key

str

Value of key.

Returns: None.

reset_all_timeouts()

Purpose: Clears all time overtime.

Parameters: None

Returns: None. Common interface keys:`get_info`, get_config, set_config, trigger_capture, get_epicraw, get_undistort_lut, check_intrinsic_accuracy, calculate_intrinsic, calculate_calibration_result, line_scan_start, stream2d_webrtc_offer.

Example

import epiceye

epiceye.set_timeout("get_epicraw", 60.0)
try:
    raw = epiceye.get_frame_in_epicraw(ip, frame_id)
finally:
    epiceye.reset_timeout("get_epicraw")
